responsibility: Implements the mutable statement-list container and iterator primitives for GENERIC tree statements. It manages allocation and caching of STATEMENT_LIST nodes, insertion and removal before or after iterator positions, preservation of side-effect flags, and convenience helpers for extracting first, last, or single non-debug expressions from nested COMPOUND_EXPR or STATEMENT_LIST structures, serving gimplification and generic-tree statement rewriting rather than GIMPLE basic-block iteration.
same_name_distinction: Implements the storage and mutation routines behind the GENERIC statement-list iterator interface defined in gcc/tree-iterator.h. Unlike the header’s tree_stmt_iterator abstraction and inline traversal helpers, this file allocates/caches STATEMENT_LIST nodes and performs list insertion, removal, and expression-selection operations.
